_help: Act 5, the royal door. Americans want to force it: unless you show them the warning (found_warning) they do, door_forced = true (the traps fire). Germans want to go slowly: unless you show them the ritual (found_ritual) it costs a tomb investigation, german_delay = true. No ally: your call, no penalty. End ids: end_forced, end_delay, end_safe.

am_open.speaker: whitfield
am_open.line: That's it, the king's own door! We've poked around long enough. Red, bring the crowbars. We're going in now.

choices.label: Show him the warning
choices.line: Read this first, Whitfield. 'He who forces the seal shall find the roof come down to be his shroud.' Look up: those ceiling stones are hanging on wedges.

choices.label: Tell him to wait
choices.line: Hold on. We don't know what's on the other side of that door.

am_backs_down.speaker: whitfield
am_backs_down.line: Huh. Well... I didn't get rich by getting buried. All right, we do it your way. Red, put those down.

am_ignores.speaker: whitfield
am_ignores.line: Wait for what? A written invitation? You've got nothing but nerves, pal. Red, put your back into it!

forced_eleanor_line.speaker: eleanor
forced_eleanor_line.line: The ceiling! Get back, everyone, get back!

ge_open.speaker: adler
ge_open.line: The royal seal. We will document every symbol and test every stone before we touch it. It will take some hours, but there is no other responsible way.

choices.label: Show him the ritual
choices.line: Professor, the chapel shows how the priests opened it: jackal, eye, the sun below the earth, the closed hand. No force, no hours of digging.

choices.label: Urge him to hurry
choices.line: Hours? We don't have hours, Professor.

ge_convinced.speaker: adler
ge_convinced.line: The opening of the way... Of course. Wilhelm, the sequence, quickly. Remarkable. We have saved half a day.

ge_refuses.speaker: adler
ge_refuses.line: Then we will make the time. A careless hand here destroys what has waited three thousand years.

ge_delay.speaker: adler
ge_delay.line: Wilhelm, the drawing board. We begin with the lintel.

delay_eleanor_line.speaker: eleanor
delay_eleanor_line.line: He's right to be careful... but by the time he's finished, we'll have very little time left inside.

alone_open.speaker: player
alone_open.line: No one to argue with now. Just the door, and what we know about it.

choices.label: Use the ritual
choices.line: Jackal, eye, the sun below the earth, the closed hand. Gently.

safe_open.speaker: player
safe_open.line: The seal gives with a sigh of old air. The royal tomb is open.
